caption: What if you could regrow like a planarian? These freshwater flatworms live under stones in ponds and streams. Cut one in half and each piece regrows what's missing: two worms. In 1898, the scientist T.H. Morgan saw a piece just 1/279th of a worm grow back into a whole worm in one to two weeks. The secret is stem cells called neoblasts, up to 30% of all its cells, which can become any body part. In 2011, researchers gave a worm with no stem cells just one neoblast, and it rebuilt the entire body. Worms trained to find food, then beheaded, relearned faster after growing a new head. Humans can do a little: a liver can regrow to nearly full size in about 3-4 weeks. Labs at inStem and NCBS in Bengaluru study planarians to learn about healing. Plot twist: in 2015, flatworms spent 5 weeks on the space station, and one came back with two heads. Which body part would YOU want to regrow? 👇
